name: slack-drafts-mobile
description: Your Slack drafts on your phone: a pinned Slack Drafts Artifact in the Claude app (the default), or a small page on your own Vercel account, that /write-slack-message drafts sync to, with Copy for Slack (links and code intact), Sent and delete.

page.title: Phone page
page.description: Where your drafts go: artifact, a pinned Slack Drafts Artifact you open in the Claude app (needs Artifacts on your claude.ai account), or vercel, a page on your own Vercel account with GitHub sign-in that works in every session. /slack-drafts-mobile sets this up. auto, the default, means vercel when a Vercel page from before 0.3 is set up, else artifact.
